entries.title: 3-dB coupler
entries.description: The ideal lossless 3-dB directional coupler (1/sqrt 2)[[1, i], [i, 1]] on two guided lanes: half of the light of each input goes to each output (Pozar, Microwave Engineering, section 7.5).

entries.title: Neutral density
entries.description: A neutral density filter: the power is multiplied by its transmission at every wavelength.

entries.title: Short-pass filter at 1 µm
entries.description: An idealised short-pass filter: 95 % transmission from 400 to 950 nm, falling linearly to 0 at 1050 nm, 0 above.

entries.title: Neutral density bench
entries.description: A laser through a neutral density of the catalogue onto a power meter: the meter reads T × 1 mW.
